_comment: What an expected failure must print (scripts/run-recipes.py). A variant's `ci.xfail` (recipes.json) marks an image where the recipe is known to fail; an entry here, keyed by intent then image, is a Python regular expression (re.search, multi-line output, stdout and stderr interleaved) the failing case's output must match, so an xfail passes only for the failure it was measured with: any other failure on that image is a FAIL. Kept outside recipes.json so the signed data file (and its serial's sha) does not change. Every entry must name an image some variant of that intent marks `xfail` (checked at start).
